historic_source.title: Report on a General Problem-Solving Program
historic_source.report: RAND P-1584, December 30, 1958; revised February 1959; IFIP 1959
historic_source.primary_claim: GPS has transform-object, apply-operator, and reduce-difference goals; method 3 chooses an operator relevant to a difference then attempts method 2 for its prerequisites.
historic_source.reconstruction_warning: Boolean finite add/del sets and executable witness are the project's modern formal reconstruction for tests; not an exact IPL/GPS historical binary trace.

research.law: For finite Boolean universe U, state S and desired full-state G, compute missing = G\S and unwanted = S\G; both are disjoint and their union is the symmetric difference; reject atoms not in U.
falsifiers: Comparing only positive goals hides unwanted true atoms when complete target states are declared.
Returning atoms not in U or counting duplicated atoms as new differences.
research.complexity: Can be composed from finite-set differences; no proof for independent machine opcode.

research.law: For finite operator O with additive effects A, deleting effects D, and missing M=G\S/unwanted W=S\G, return positive witnesses A∩M and negative witnesses D∩W. Mark 'relevant to current difference' iff either witness is nonempty. Relevance is only an effect-based heuristic, not proof of executability, progress, or planning completeness.
witnesses: S=[battery],G=[battery,signal],O adds signal => positive witness signal.
S=[noise,signal],G=[signal],O deletes noise => negative witness noise.
Adding signal but also deleting battery may be relevant yet fail to reduce distance to a goal requiring both.
falsifiers: Declaring an operator irrelevant when it removes an unwanted atom.
Claiming selected operator always strictly reduces total goal difference or proves reachability.
research.complexity: Intersection of effects and difference is computable; novelty is an explicit stable historical search-heuristic witness, not a new D2 control form.

research.law: For an operator relevant under the preceding witness, return unmet preconditions P\S. If empty the operator is applicable, otherwise it is not yet applicable and the missing preconditions are diagnostic subgoals. Never execute a blocked operator, return 'blocked' as its prospective successor.
witnesses: Operator adds signal but requires battery while state lacks battery => relevance yes; missing precondition battery; application blocked.
If all operator preconditions are present then one successor is (S\D)∪A, regardless whether that successor is closer to G.
falsifiers: Execute operator while at least one precondition is false.
Conflate a relevant operator with a successful or complete plan.
research.complexity: A diagnostically valuable derived relation; not identical to full STRIPS regression or D2 evaluator.
